descriptionByLocale.it:
Come Junior Business Risk Officer, si unirà al Dipartimento Business Risk Management (BRM), una prima linea chiave della funzione di difesa che lavora all'interfaccia tra le funzioni di business e controllo. Collaborando a stretto contatto con i team di Sales e Compliance Istituzionali, aiuterete a facilitare la crescita sostenibile delle imprese, assicurando che le relazioni con i clienti siano valutate attraverso una lente pragmatica e basata sui rischi, rispettando gli obblighi normativi della Banca.
Questo ruolo si trova all'incrocio tra business e rischio. Potrai lavorare direttamente con i team di front-office, fornendo indicazioni pratiche in tutto il client di bordo e ciclo di vita, bilanciando gli obiettivi commerciali con una gestione del rischio sonoro.
Principali responsabilità

• Verificare e valutare le richieste di apertura dei conti per i clienti istituzionali, principalmente per le società operative, le istituzioni finanziarie e altri partner esterni, con un focus su AML/CTF, sanzioni, reputazione, conformità fiscale e rischi transfrontalieri.

• Agire come partner di rischio affidabile per il reparto vendite fornendo consulenza tempestiva, pragmatica e basata sul rischio su potenziali e relazioni client esistenti.

• Condurre le valutazioni di conformità delle imposte, compresi i requisiti di FATCA, CRS e Intermediario Qualificato (QI).

• Eseguire revisioni periodiche delle relazioni con i clienti esistenti, in particolare le istituzioni finanziarie e i partner esterni.

• Condurre attività di monitoraggio delle transazioni per un portafoglio designato di clienti istituti finanziari.

• Partecipa a incontri con potenziali clienti e clienti esistenti in cui è richiesto l'ingresso di Business Risk Management.

• Collaborare con Vendite, Compliance e altri stakeholder interni per facilitare l'accesso efficiente a bordo mantenendo adeguati standard di rischio.

• Contribuire al continuo miglioramento dei processi di bordo, dei controlli dei rischi e delle procedure interne.

• Buona conoscenza, o forte interesse, del quadro normativo svizzero applicabile alle istituzioni finanziarie, tra cui l'Anti-Money Laundering Act (AMLA), AMLO-FINMA, il Codice di condotta delle banche svizzere (CDB 20), sanziona i regolamenti e la relativa guida FINMA.

• L'esperienza in Business Risk Management, Compliance, AML/KYC o un'altra funzione di controllo all'interno del settore dei servizi finanziari è un bene.

• Forte interesse a lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di front-office in un ambiente dinamico e orientato al business.

• La comprensione dei quadri di conformità fiscale come FATCA, CRS e QI è un vantaggio.

• Laurea in Giurisprudenza, Economia, Finanza o un campo correlato è un bene.

• Eccellente capacità analitiche, organizzative e di problem solving.

• Capacità di prendere decisioni equilibrate e basate sul rischio, considerando gli obiettivi commerciali.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la fiducia di impegnarsi costruttivamente con le funzioni di business e controllo.

• Alto livello di integrità, giudizio professionale e discrezione.

• È richiesta una fluidità in inglese e francese. Il tedesco o un'altra lingua è considerato un bene.
Data di inizio: asap

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Junior Business Risk Officer, you will join the Business Risk Management (BRM) Department, a key first line of defense function working at the interface between the business and control functions. Partnering closely with the Institutional Sales and Compliance teams, you will help facilitate sustainable business growth by ensuring that client relationships are assessed through a pragmatic, risk-based lens while meeting the Bank's regulatory obligations.
This role sits at the intersection of business and risk. You will work directly with front-office teams, providing practical guidance throughout the client onboarding and lifecycle, balancing commercial objectives with sound risk management.
Key Responsibilities

• Review and assess account opening requests for institutional clients, primarily for operating companies, financial institutions and other external partners, with a focus on AML/CTF, sanctions, reputational, tax compliance and cross-border risks.

• Act as a trusted risk partner to the Sales Department by providing timely, pragmatic and risk-based advice on prospective and existing client relationships.

• Conduct tax compliance assessments, including FATCA, CRS and Qualified Intermediary (QI) requirements.

• Perform periodic reviews of existing client relationships, particularly financial institutions and external partners.

• Conduct transaction monitoring activities for a designated portfolio of financial institution clients.

• Participate in meetings with prospective and existing clients where Business Risk Management input is required.

• Collaborate with Sales, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to facilitate efficient onboarding while maintaining appropriate risk standards.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of onboarding processes, risk controls and internal procedures.

• Good knowledge of, or a strong interest in, the Swiss regulatory framework applicable to financial institutions, including the Anti-Money Laundering Act (AMLA), AMLO-FINMA, the Swiss Banks' Code of Conduct (CDB 20), sanctions regulations and relevant FINMA guidance.

• Experience in Business Risk Management, Compliance, AML/KYC or another control function within the financial services industry is an asset.

• Strong interest in working closely with front-office teams in a dynamic, business-oriented environment.

• Understanding of tax compliance frameworks such as FATCA, CRS and QI is an advantage.

• University degree in Law, Economics, Finance or a related field is an asset.

• Excellent analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to make balanced, risk-based decisions while considering commercial objectives.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage constructively with both business and control functions.

• High level of integrity, professional judgement and discretion.

• Fluency in English and French is required. German or another language is considered an asset.
Starting date : asap

descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Junior Business Risk Officer treten Sie der Abteilung Business Risk Management (BRM) bei, einer wichtigen ersten Verteidigungslinie, die an der Schnittstelle zwischen den Geschäfts- und Kontrollfunktionen arbeitet. Indem Sie eng mit den Teams für institutionellen Vertrieb und Compliance zusammenarbeiten, tragen Sie zu einem nachhaltigen Geschäftswachstum bei, indem Sie sicherstellen, dass die Kundenbeziehungen durch eine pragmatische, risikobasierte Linse bewertet werden und gleichzeitig die regulatorischen Verpflichtungen der Bank erfüllt werden.
Diese Rolle sitzt an der Schnittstelle von Geschäft und Risiko. Sie arbeiten direkt mit Front-Office-Teams zusammen und bieten praktische Beratung während des gesamten Kunden-Onboardings und -Lebenszyklus und balancieren kommerzielle Ziele mit einem soliden Risikomanagement.
Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Überprüfung und Bewertung von Kontoeröffnungsanträgen für institutionelle Kunden, vor allem für Betreibergesellschaften, Finanzinstitute und andere externe Partner, mit Schwerpunkt auf AML/CTF, Sanktionen, Reputation, Tax Compliance und grenzüberschreitenden Risiken.

• Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Risikopartner für die Verkaufsabteilung, indem Sie zeitnahe, pragmatische und risikobasierte Beratung zu potenziellen und bestehenden Kundenbeziehungen anbieten.

• Führen Sie Steuerkonformitätsbewertungen durch, einschließlich FATCA-, CRS- und Qualified Intermediary (QI) -Anforderungen.

• Durchführung regelmäßiger Überprüfungen bestehender Kundenbeziehungen, insbesondere von Finanzinstituten und externen Partnern.

• Durchführung von Transaktionsüberwachungsaktivitäten für ein bestimmtes Portfolio von Finanzinstitutionskunden.

• Nehmen Sie an Besprechungen mit potenziellen und bestehenden Kunden teil, bei denen Business Risk Management-Input erforderlich ist.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Compliance und anderen internen Stakeholdern, um ein effizientes Onboarding zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig angemessene Risikostandards einzuhalten.

• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Onboarding-Prozessen, Risikokontrollen und internen Verfahren.

• Gute Kenntnisse oder ein starkes Interesse am schweizerischen Regulierungsrahmen für Finanzinstitute, einschließlich des Geldwäschegesetzes (AMLA), AMLO-FINMA, des Verhaltenskodex der Schweizer Banken (CDB 20), Sanktionsvorschriften und einschlägiger FINMA-Leitlinien.

• Erfahrung in Business Risk Management, Compliance, AML / KYC oder einer anderen Kontrollfunktion in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche ist ein Gewinn.

• Starkes Interesse an einer engen Zusammenarbeit mit Front-Office-Teams in einem dynamischen, geschäftsorientierten Umfeld.

• Das Verständnis von Tax Compliance Frameworks wie FATCA, CRS und QI ist von Vorteil.

• Universitätsabschluss in Recht, Wirtschaft, Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich ist ein Vermögenswert.

• Hervorragende analytische, organisatorische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, ausgewogene, risikobasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und dabei kommerzielle Ziele zu berücksichtigen.

• Starke Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, mit dem Vertrauen, sich konstruktiv sowohl mit Geschäfts- als auch Kontrollfunktionen zu beschäftigen.

• Hohe Integrität, professionelles Urteilsvermögen und Diskretion.

• Fließend in Englisch und Französisch ist erforderlich. Deutsch oder eine andere Sprache gilt als Aktivposten.

Se ti vedi come un Craftsman che ama progettare, brainstorming, rivedere e testare, allora questo è il posto giusto per te! Come Ingegnere Software sul team di sicurezza Piattaforme, svilupperai e manterrai sistemi software focalizzati sui mecanismi Web e Mobile Authentication, sull'integrazione di 2fa e di terze parti. La sicurezza è al centro di ciò che facciamo — contribuirà a costruire sistemi sicuri e resilienti che proteggono le identità degli utenti, applicano i controlli di accesso e sostengono i più elevati standard di integrità dei dati. Interagirete con i proprietari di prodotti, progettisti, IT e altri ingegneri software per fornire soluzioni di piattaforma affidabili e di alta qualità. Che ci fai qui?

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di prodotti e progettisti per comprendere i requisiti, discutere le soluzioni e tradurre le loro esigenze in implementazioni robuste
• Tieniti aggiornato sulle tecnologie all'avanguardia, inclusi gli strumenti e le pratiche di sviluppo potenziati dall'IA, e contribuisci attivamente alla direzione tecnica del team
• Esplorare e integrare le funzionalità AI per migliorare i servizi della piattaforma, la produttività dello sviluppatore o l'esperienza dell'utente
• Contribuisci alla progettazione e all'implementazione di sistemi sicuri garantendo il rispetto delle normative KYC e delle best practice di sicurezza
• Coordinare e organizzare l'evoluzione e la consegna dei prodotti
• Fornire supporto sulle applicazioni ai nostri utenti interni ed esterni
• Utilizzare moderni framework di test per garantire la qualità delle applicazioni
• Una laurea in informatica o equivalente
• Min 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni pronte alla produzione
• Esperienza nello sviluppo Java e la volontà di imparare i framework open source come Maven, Spring e Hibernate
• Conoscenza dei servizi RESTful
• Conoscenza di Linux, Docker, Jenkins, Tomcat, Kubernetes, Sonar e Databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Redis)
• Conoscenza del sistema di controllo della versione Git
• Familiare o disposto a lavorare con Kibana e Grafana
• Conoscenza delle architetture orientate agli eventi
• Familiare o disposto a lavorare con lo sviluppo guidato da test: TestNG, Wiremock, ecc.
• Solida capacità analitiche e problem solving
• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti Agile
• Buone capacità di comunicazione, giocatore di squadra, rigoroso e autonomo
• La familiarità con gli standard e i protocolli di sicurezza (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, PKI, ecc.) è un plus
• Fluente in inglese, il francese è un bene
• Esperienza con lo sviluppo di React o frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript) è un plus
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking a Software Engineer who is passionate about delivering high-quality software. If you see yourself as a Craftsman who enjoys designing, brainstorming, reviewing and testing, then this is the right place for you!
As a Software Engineer on the Platforms Security team, you will develop and maintain software systems focused on Web and Mobile Authentication mecanisms, 2fa and third party integration. Security is at the heart of what we do — you will contribute to building secure, resilient systems that protect user identities, enforce access controls, and uphold the highest standards of data integrity. You will interact with product owners, designers, IT and other software engineers to deliver reliable and high-quality platform solutions.
What will you do here?

• Actively participate in the development of our security scope by creating efficient and reliable code

• Collaborate closely with product owners and designers to understand requirements, discuss solutions and translate their needs into robust implementations

• Keep yourself up-to-date on cutting-edge technologies — including AI-powered development tools and practices — and actively contribute to the technical direction of the team

• Explore and integrate AI capabilities where relevant to improve platform services, developer productivity or user experience

• Contribute to the design and implementation of secure systems ensuring compliance with KYC regulations and security best practices

• Coordinate and organize product evolution and delivery

• Provide support on the applications to our internal and external users

• Use modern test frameworks to ensure the quality of the applications

• A degree in computer science or equivalent

• Min 5 years of experience in development of production-ready applications

• Experience in Java development and willingness to learn open source frameworks such as Maven, Spring and Hibernate

• Knowledge of RESTful services

• Knowledge of Linux, Docker, Jenkins, Tomcat, Kubernetes, Sonar and Databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Redis)

• Knowledge of Git version control system

• Familiar or willing to work with Kibana and Grafana

• Knowledge of event-driven architectures

• Familiar or willing to work with test-driven development: TestNG, Wiremock, etc.

• Solid analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Experience working in Agile environments

• Good communication skills, team player, rigorous and autonomous

• Familiarity with security standards and protocols (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, PKI, etc.) is a plus

• Fluent in English, French is an asset

• Experience with React or frontend development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript) is a plus

descriptionByLocale.it:

Definiamo, analizziamo e realizziamo il futuro delle soluzioni di cliente offerte da Swissquote. Manteniamo anche quelle applicazioni per garantire sempre la migliore esperienza del cliente nel suo viaggio. Collaborando a stretto contatto con il reparto strategia di prodotto siamo anche il ponte tra la strategia di crescita dell’azienda e le soluzioni corrispondenti messe in atto, essendo poi i protagonisti che danno vita concreta alla visione definita. • Comunicare e gestire le relazioni con gli stakeholder per fornire il miglior prodotto

• Analizzare e privilegiare il feedback dei clienti per la guida di miglioramenti continui e soddisfare le aspettative degli utenti
• Collabora con i progettisti per ottimizzare l'esperienza utente (ad esempio test A/B, mobile & web)
• Atto come esperto di materia per il prodotto, sostenere i team di business e sviluppo attraverso la condivisione della conoscenza e il mentoring
• Mantenere la consapevolezza delle tendenze del mercato e dell'industria per una migliore ottimizzazione della definizione delle soluzioni
• Fornire indicazioni sulla visione al Team di Sviluppo e spiegare i requisiti
• Creare e mantenere una documentazione completa per i riferimenti delle funzionalità aziendali
• Monitorare i KPI per eseguire la priorità delle funzionalità e migliorare le decisioni basate sui dati
• Assicurare la validazione incrementale del business per assicurarsi che le funzionalità sviluppate soddisfino i requisiti aziendali

descriptionByLocale.en:
Department Mission - Software Engineering Platforms
The Software Engineering Platforms department is dedicated to the customer's journey in Swissquote. We define, analyze and make alive the future of client facing solutions offered by Swissquote. We also maintain those applications to always ensure the best client experience in his journey.
By collaborating closely with product strategy department we also are the bridge between company’s growth strategy and the corresponding solutions put in place, being then the core actors giving concrete life to the vision defined.
By working hand in hand with the internal departments and the business that they represent we ensure to always move towards clients and stakeholders needs.

Team Mission
The Institutional and Wealth section designs, develops and maintains passive investment platforms on Web and mobile for retail clients (InvestEasy, 3a easy, Save Easy, and more to come) as well as the whole set of solutions for institutional clients (APIs, SQPro platform, bridges with FX external platforms…)
You will be part of Institutional and Wealth Conception team , working together with 3 other product owners, a product designer and an offshore business analyst.

The mission of the team is to transform company strategy into feasible solutions and drive the product's evolution together with the software engineering teams. Your team is focusing on all aspects related to Institutional business and Wealth management across all business lines (Forex, securities, crypto).
Your responsibilities:

• Communicate and manage relationships with stakeholders to deliver the best product

• Define and document business requirements to capture business needs and constraints, and guide the development process

• Define and maintain a product roadmap to provide a clear direction to the Development teams and stakeholders

• Prioritize the product backlog to ensure that the most valuable work is addressed first and maximize ROI

• Analyze and prioritize client feedback for driving continuous improvements and meeting user expectations

• Collaborate with designers to optimize the user experience (e.g A/B testing, mobile & web)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert for the product, support business and development teams by knowledge sharing and mentoring

• Maintain awareness of market and industry trends for better optimization of solution definition

• Provide guidance on the vision to the Development Team and explain requirements

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for business feature references

• Monitor KPIs to perform feature prioritization and enhance data-driven decisions

• Ensure incremental business validation to make sure developed features meet business requirements

• Educational background: Master or Bachelor degree

• You have a deep understanding of securities trading, forex trading a plus

• You have several years of experience as product owner, business analyst or a similar role

• You have several years of experience working with agile software development teams, and a good understanding of product development in a disciplined agile environment

• You have experience working closely with product designers to build end client solutions on web platforms, mobile a plus

• You have a thorough understanding of the product quality aspect, with prior experience of planning and coordinating business validation activities

• You are an excellent communicator and storyteller with different stakeholders, able to face stakeholders as well institutional clients

• You have experience in sharing your business knowledge and mentoring other team members

• Fluent in English

descriptionByLocale.en:
As an AI Enablement Engineer, you will be responsible for accelerating AI adoption across the Technology department while helping the wider organization identify and implement high-impact AI initiatives.
Reporting directly to the Head Talent & Methodology, you will work closely with Engineering Managers, the Tech Drive (Technical Governance), Communities of Practice, Methodology, Human Resources, Product Strategy, Operational Products, and other business departments.
Your mission is simple:
Make AI a core engineering capability at Swissquote.
You will continuously identify opportunities where AI can improve engineering excellence, operational efficiency, and product innovation, while ensuring adoption follows Swissquote's governance and quality standards.
Rather than only delivering training, you will build a sustainable enablement ecosystem that allows teams to become autonomous AI practitioners.
Key Responsibilities
AI Enablement & Learning

• Design, build and continuously evolve the Software Engineering AI Enablement Program.

• Deliver hands-on workshops, technical trainings, bootcamps and office hours.

• Coordinate AI learning initiatives across Software Engineering and Technology.

• Develop practical learning paths covering Generative AI, AI-assisted software development, prompting, AI agents, automation and emerging AI capabilities.

• Create reusable playbooks, best practices and engineering guidelines.

• Measure AI adoption and continuously improve enablement programs through feedback and metrics.
Partnership Engineering Excellence

• Work alongside engineering teams to identify opportunities where AI can significantly improve software development lifecycle productivity.

• Help teams integrate AI into software design, coding, testing, documentation, operations and maintenance.

• Prototype AI-powered engineering workflows and reference implementations.

• Actively collaborate with internal Communities of Practice and CoP Manager

• Organize technical talks, demos, hackathons and AI events

• Encourage experimentation while promoting responsible AI usage.
Working together with the Tech Drive organization, you will:

• Contribute to Software Engineering AI standards and best practices.

• Participate in defining AI governance for engineering activities.

• Ensure AI usage aligns with security, compliance and regulatory requirements.

• Identify recurring engineering challenges and propose AI-driven improvements.
Business Enablement
Beyond engineering, you will collaborate with Operational Products, Product Strategy, HR and business stakeholders to:

• Identify high-value AI opportunities.

• Facilitate AI discovery workshops in collaboration with the Methodology Team

• Prototype business solutions using Generative AI.

• Support departments during AI adoption and change management.

• Act as a trusted advisor on AI opportunities and implementation approaches.
Additional responsibilities - Innovation & External Representation
As one of Swissquote's AI ambassadors, you will:

• Monitor AI trends, technologies and industry best practices.

• Evaluate emerging AI tools and frameworks.

• Represent Software Engineering internally across Swissquote.

• Contribute to Swissquote's visibility externally through conferences, meetups, articles or technical communities when appropriate.

Required Qualifications

• 2-5 years of experience in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Developer Experience or Technical Consulting.

• Strong software engineering background with experience building production systems.

• Practical experience using Claude or similar LLMs in your own work: prompt engineering, using AI coding assistants, building small internal tools or scripts that leverage LLM APIs

• Demonstrated experience leading technical enablement, mentoring or training engineers.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong understanding of software engineering best practices.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong bias toward execution and continuous improvement.

• Passion for learning, experimentation and knowledge sharing.

• Curiosity about AI governance, security and cost management, and willingness to learn Swissquote’s specific constraints and policies
Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Claude Code, OpenWebUI or similar AI development environments.

• Exposure to spec-as-source, agentic workflows, or RAG patterns, even in small side projects

• Prior experience running brown-bag sessions, workshops, or internal documentation initiatives.

• Familiarity with Claude, OpenAI, OpenWebUI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar AI platforms.

• Experience with RAG, AI Agents, MCP, orchestration frameworks or agentic workflows.

• Knowledge of AI governance, security and regulatory requirements.

• Experience working in regulated environments.

• Public speaking experience, conference presentations or technical content creation is a strong plus.

Vous apporterez l'analyse pertinente, les recommandations et les idées pratiques pour façonner la prise de décision axée sur les données, appuyer les projets et les objectifs, les initiatives stratégiques et la prise de décisions.
Votre mission :

• Recueillir, interpréter et présenter les données pour éclairer les décisions commerciales.

• Participer à la réussite et à la vision du produit en aidant à la recherche, aux données, aux rapports et aux idées nécessaires.

• Appuyer les idées et la planification stratégiques ainsi que les projets clés de la feuille de route et des principales initiatives du projet.

• Propriété du tableau de bord : développer des tableaux de bord de produits, les entretenir et effectuer les améliorations et les modifications nécessaires.

• Préparer des recherches et des rapports pour la gestion des produits et les équipes qui communiquent efficacement les conclusions et les modèles à l'aide de données pertinentes.

• Communiquer les rapports et les résultats de l'analyse des données au Ministère ainsi qu'aux principaux intervenants des différents ministères de la Banque.

• Présenter les conclusions et les recommandations stratégiques au leadership de la direction, en fournissant des descriptions claires appuyées par de solides données.

• Assurer la qualité, la validation et la documentation des rapports.

• Contribuer à l'évolution continue des meilleures pratiques et outils analytiques au sein de l'équipe.

• Aider à la gestion des produits à n'importe quelle étape des données d'Insights et des activités ou besoins de recherche.

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour appuyer des initiatives nécessitant une expertise analytique approfondie.

• Baccalauréat (analyse des données, affaires, économie).

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience de travail pertinente dans le domaine de l'analyse des affaires et/ou des rapports, de préférence dans les services financiers ou les environnements technologiques.

• Compétences et expérience dans la création de tableaux de bord avec le logiciel Tableau et compétences SQL. Python est un plus.

• Excellentes compétences dans les tableurs Excel et la création de présentations dans PowerPoint.

• Forte connaissance des données : capacité de manipuler, d'interpréter et de synthétiser des ensembles de données complexes avec une grande précision et une grande attention aux détails.

• Un état d'esprit analytique, des compétences numériques et une excellente pensée critique.

• Un bon sens des affaires et une réflexion stratégique solide; capable de relier les données recueillies aux résultats opérationnels.

• Expérience éprouvée qui a influencé les intervenants et travaillé avec les cadres supérieurs pour diriger les décisions stratégiques.

• Très bonnes compétences en communication écrite et verbale.

• Capacité de gérer de multiples priorités, d'opérer de façon autonome et de respecter des délais serrés dans un environnement rapide.

• L'esprit de collaboration, l'orientation client-premier, et le dévouement à l'amélioration et à l'apprentissage continus.

• Fluent en anglais et en français, l'allemand est un plus.

QS3

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di agente di gestione delle registrazioni all'interno del nostro dipartimento di Servizi Campus, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione digitale dei nostri processi interni. Sarete responsabili della digitalizzazione, dell'indicizzazione e della classificazione dei documenti fisici ed elettronici per garantire la loro accessibilità, conformità e conservazione a lungo termine. Questa posizione è ideale per qualcuno orientato al dettaglio, organizzato e motivato da un continuo miglioramento dei flussi di lavoro dei documenti. Le tue responsabilità:
• digitalizzazione dei documenti — Preparare, scansionare e eseguire controlli di qualità sui documenti in arrivo.
• Indicizzazione strutturata — Assegna metadati accurati per garantire il recupero rapido e affidabile.
• Classificazione dei documenti — Organizzare i record digitali e fisici secondo gli standard interni.
• Controllo della qualità — Verificare accuratezza, leggibilità e coerenza dei file digitalizzati.
• Gestione del flusso di lavoro dei documenti — Contribuire a ottimizzare i processi di archiviazione e flusso di informazioni.
• Supporto interno — Squadre di assistenza con ricerche documentali, recupero e consultazione.

• Almeno 2 anni di esperienza in questa funzione o simile
• Confortevole con strumenti di scansione, sistemi di gestione dei documenti e ambienti digitali.
• Forte capacità organizzative, attenzione ai dettagli, e stretta adesione alle procedure.
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente mentre collabora con più dipartimenti.
• Competenza in francese e inglese
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Records Management Agent within our Campus Services department, you will play a key role in the digital transformation of our internal processes. You will be responsible for the digitization, indexing, and classification of physical and electronic documents to ensure their accessibility, compliance, and long-term preservation.
This position is ideal for someone detail oriented, organized, and motivated by continuous improvement in document workflows.
Your responsibilities:

• Document digitization — Prepare, scan, and perform quality checks on incoming documents.

• Structured indexing — Assign accurate metadata to ensure fast and reliable retrieval.

• Document classification — Organize digital and physical records according to internal standards.

• Quality control — Verify accuracy, readability, and consistency of digitized files.

• Document workflow management — Contribute to optimizing archiving and information flow processes.

• Internal support — Assist teams with document searches, retrieval, and consultation.

• “Agente en information documentaire CFC / Agent en information documentaire CFC” or equivalent

• At least 2 years of experience in this function or similar

• Comfortable with scanning tools, document management systems and digital environments.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and strict adherence to procedures.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple departments.

• Proficiency in French and English

descriptionByLocale.en:

• Act as a primary point of contact for internal departments requiring technical and business support.

• Analyze large datasets and conduct investigations using SQL (Oracle, Postgres).

• Develop automation tools and scripts (Python) to increase operational efficiency and reduce manual workload.

• Produce complex data extractions and analyses for business, legal, compliance, and operational teams.

• Participate in internal reconciliations and database integrity controls to ensure data consistency across platforms.

• Monitor critical production processes and proactively identify anomalies.

• Contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Eager to work on critical systems.

• Interest in financial markets, banking operations, and trading systems.

• Ability to understand both technical systems and business processes.

• Strong communication skills and ability to interact with multiple stakeholders.

• Autonomous, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.

• Good knowledge of French and strong working knowledge of English (minimum B2)

SQ2

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ti unirai al team IT Platform Operations del Dipartimento IT, il cui ruolo è quello di gestire lo strato tra infrastrutture grezze e servizi corporate-facing della banca: il tessuto middleware a livello di applicazione, il piano di controllo Kubernetes e la superficie user-facing della piattaforma AI sovrana della banca. Il candidato ideale possederà una profonda esperienza nei sistemi operativi di ingegneria delle piattaforme Kubernetes-native su scala, e porterà l'integrazione di strumenti AI open-source all'interno di un ambiente aziendale regolamentato, garantendo al contempo scale di inferenza del modello di grande lingua (LLM). La vostra competenza aiuterà il vostro team a fornire la piattaforma su cui la banca fornisce l'accesso governato alle capacità AI interne ed esterne — inferenza distribuita, flussi di lavoro agentici, notebook e chatbots — costruito sulla parte superiore della GPU e il substrato di servizio fornito dai team Systems & Storage. Con il vostro team, lavorerete a stretto contatto con IT Architects, Observability & Performance Analysts, la funzione Cybersecurity e i team di Systems per pianificare ed eseguire l'obiettivo a lungo termine del dipartimento di una capacità di AI sovrana che funziona sotto il proprio governo della banca — la sovranità dei dati, la sicurezza dei contenuti, la pronta iniezione di difese, l'audit del flusso di agentic e il controllo dei costi sulla spesa API esterna — e che è AI Act- e DORA-ready.
